protocol.rate_selection: maximize min(exact P(A), exact P(B)) independently per observation; tie to smaller clutter rate; do not exclude a weakly balanced case
protocol.joint_cells: all 21 alive totals (0..20) by 3 final-frame clutter counts (0..2)
protocol.per_run_comparison: full joint TV and maximum absolute signed cell error against 1000 exact multinomial IID draws at each particle count; also report mode, alive, clutter and evidence errors
protocol.cell_group_comparison: mean signed error per cell across six 2048-particle seeds; familywise q95 of the maximum absolute cell mean from 1000 independent six-draw exact-posterior groups
protocol.replication_rule: replicated_joint_tail if both observations have >=2/6 2048-particle full-joint-TV errors above their own IID q95; replicated_cell_shift if at least one same (alive, clutter) cell exceeds its observation's familywise group q95 in both observations with the same signed error; report both flags, neither selects a sampler move
protocol.run_order: primary reference, replica reference; then primary 512/2048 seeds 1000..1005 and replica 512/2048 seeds 1010..1015
protocol.interpretation: absolute diagnostic on two four-slot/five-frame cases, not the four-slot/eight-frame primary case; no 8192 or untouched holdout
